name: opencode-nono-audit-tests
description: Test suite entry point for the opencode-nono-audit spec. Exists so Node's CommonJS module resolution can load this directory as a single test file when invoked via `opencode-cost-diagnosis-node --test tests/opencode-nono-audit/` (Node 22's --test flag treats its arg as a module specifier, not a directory glob). The `main` field routes that load to run.js, which detects the directory-mode context and walks for *.test.js files.
